description: The public directory of UK grassroots live-music venues in a town or city (listings, no booking): capacity, backline, PA, engineer and genres booked. Towns filed under a bigger city are matched to it (e.g. Paisley -> Glasgow). One venue can be looked up by `name`. Filter by genre, capacity, PA/backline/engineer and live-music day. GigXchange MEMBER venues open to a gig request on a date are in search_available_venues. Paginated.

day.description: Optional: venues that host live music on "today", "tomorrow" or a weekday (mon..sun), UK time.

genre.description: Optional genre the venue books, e.g. "metal", "jazz", "hip hop". Free-text match; venues list genres loosely.

has_backline.description: Only venues with drums or amps provided.

has_engineer.description: Only venues with an in-house sound engineer.

has_pa.description: Only venues with a house PA.

name.description: A venue's name, e.g. "Brudenell Social Club". With a name, city is optional and narrows the match (other filters are not applied).

offset.description: Row offset for paging (use next_offset from a prior call).

name: search_venues
title: Search grassroots music venues
